name: poste
description: Unofficial, independent guide to Slovenian post offices (opening hours, open now), Pošta Slovenije parcel lockers and mailboxes. Not affiliated with Pošta Slovenije.

interface.longDescription:
poste is an independent, unofficial service by poste.cc — not Pošta Slovenije and not affiliated with it. It brings Pošta Slovenije's post offices, parcel lockers (paketomati) and street mailboxes into ChatGPT — the same data as poste.cc. Ask "is the post office in Koper open now?" or "which post offices in 1000 Ljubljana are open on Saturday?" and ChatGPT finds the branches and reads their opening hours with Slovenian public holidays applied.

- Search post offices, parcel lockers and mailboxes by place, postal code, branch code, address or nickname
- Find the nearest post offices, parcel lockers and mailboxes to a location, with distance
- Get one post office's hours for the next 7 days, whether it is open now, on-duty and mobile post office schedules, services, phone numbers and nearby alternatives

Every result links to the full page on poste.cc. Read-only, no account needed. Works in English and Slovenian.

Limitations: covers Pošta Slovenije in Slovenia only — no parcel tracking, postage prices or mailbox collection times. poste.cc is unofficial and not affiliated with Pošta Slovenije.
capabilities: Search Slovenian post offices, parcel lockers and mailboxes
Nearest post offices, parcel lockers and mailboxes
Post office opening hours and details
defaultPrompt: Is the post office in Koper open now?
Katere pošte s poštno številko 1000 Ljubljana so odprte v soboto?
Where is the nearest parcel locker to Prešernov trg in Ljubljana?

positive.description: Is a town's post office open now and on Saturday
positive.prompt: Is the post office in Koper open now? And until when on Saturday?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Koper's four branches (6101, 6103, 6104, 6105) with their open-now status and hours, and says they are all closed on Saturdays.

positive.description: Branches of a postal code open on Saturday, asked in Slovenian
positive.prompt: Katere pošte s poštno številko 1000 Ljubljana so odprte v soboto?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers in Slovenian: of the 1000 Ljubljana branches (1101–1135) only 1106 Ljubljana, Pražakova ulica 3, is open on Saturday, 08:00–12:00.

positive.description: Nearest parcel locker and post office to a location
positive.prompt: I'm standing at 46.0569, 14.5058 in Ljubljana. Where's the nearest parcel locker, and which post office nearby will be open first tomorrow morning?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Paketomat 1718 at Pražakova ulica 3 (about 70 m, 24/7) and Pošta 1106 Ljubljana at the same address, opening at 08:00.

positive.description: Mailbox on a street and the branch that empties it
positive.prompt: Kje je poštni nabiralnik na Celovški cesti 121 v Ljubljani in katera pošta ga prazni?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers in Slovenian: there is a mailbox at Celovška cesta 121, Ljubljana, emptied by 1102 Ljubljana.

positive.description: Schedule of a mobile post office
positive.prompt: When is the mobile post office 1276 Primskovo at its stop this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the stop "Pri trgovini Golob, Gradišče 8" and the days and times the van is there (09:45–10:45 on most weekdays, 16:00–17:00 on Thursday), closed on weekends.

negative.prompt: Where is my parcel? Tracking number RR123456785SI from Pošta Slovenije.

negative.description: Post offices outside Slovenia are not covered
negative.prompt: Is the main post office in Zagreb open on Saturday?
How much does it cost to send a 2 kg parcel from Ljubljana to Germany?

review.commerce_description: poste does not sell products or process payments; it only returns public post office information.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search_postal_locations, find_nearest and get_post_office — Slovenian post offices with opening hours (public holidays, on-duty and mobile post offices), parcel lockers and mailboxes, with links to poste.cc.

sl-SI.subtitle: Odpiralni časi pošt (neuradno)
sl-SI.description:
poste je neodvisna, neuradna storitev spletne strani poste.cc — ni Pošta Slovenije in z njo ni povezana. V ChatGPT prinese pošte, paketomate in poštne nabiralnike Pošte Slovenije — iste podatke kot na poste.cc. Vprašajte "ali je pošta v Kopru zdaj odprta?" ali "katere pošte v Ljubljani so odprte v soboto?" in ChatGPT poišče poslovalnice ter prebere odpiralni čas z upoštevanimi prazniki.

- iskanje pošt, paketomatov in nabiralnikov po kraju, poštni številki, naslovu ali vzdevku
- najbližje pošte, paketomati in nabiralniki glede na lokacijo
- odpiralni čas pošte za 7 dni, ali je odprta zdaj, dežurne in premične pošte, storitve in telefoni

Brez računa, samo branje podatkov. Samo Pošta Slovenije v Sloveniji. poste.cc je neuraden in ni povezan s Pošto Slovenije.
